external_methods.name: scE2G
external_methods.primary_input: per-cluster ATAC fragments .tsv.gz with .tbi, raw RNA count matrix for multiome, verified cell IDs

external_methods.name: ENCODE-rE2G

external_methods.name: ENCODE-E2G

external_methods.name: GraphReg
external_methods.primary_input: sequence/epigenomic tracks and 3D contacts and CAGE; target cell context required

match_contract.identifiers: canonical unversioned human Ensembl gene IDs; one-to-one audited map from Stage75 symbols
match_contract.coordinate_build: explicit GRCh38 agreement required; no unapproved liftover
match_contract.role: annotation or independently qualified corroboration after separate authority
match_contract.never: gene name overlap as edge evidence; predicted score as causality; positive=validation; unknown/NOT_ESTIMABLE=zero
match_contract.required_link_for_edge_level: authenticated TF motif/binding-to-element plus exactly joined enhancer interval/gene ID and provenance

result.explanation: Only metadata/structural evidence was audited; processed ATAC does not substitute for indexed fragments in native scE2G.
